exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 200 women in Turkey, 100 who delivered vaginally and 100 who delivered via cesarean section
finding: While mode of delivery did not significantly affect mother-infant bonding, maternal age at delivery and the number of children were negatively correlated with mother-infant bonding scores.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not play a role on mother-infant bonding among this study population.
